info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector DictionaryExamples API

params.name: api-version
params.description: Version of the API requested by the client. Value must be **3.0**.

params.name: from
params.description: Specifies the language of the input text. The source language must be one of the supported languages included in the `dictionary` scope.

params.name: to
params.description: Specifies the language of the output text. The target language must be one of the supported languages included in the `dictionary` scope.

items.docs: Provides examples that show how terms in the dictionary are used in context. This operation is used in tandem with `Dictionary lookup`.
